thread:
emma: Lynx security just emailed asking for the full set of artifacts from our March engagement and a clear remediation timeline they can present to their vendor risk team. They want: PDF report (redacted), raw scanner outputs (Nessus/Snyk), SBOM, mapping to CVEs, and a week-by-week ETA. Deadline: Thu EOD. Who can own packaging + delivery?

raj: I can pull the raw exports. i'll include: nessus.xml, snyk-report.json, sbom.csv, and a raw findings CSV. will also add a column for jira_ticket. planning to leave severity as numeric + word.

sarah: legal flagged two things last time: (1) redact internal hostnames, IPs, and staff emails, (2) ensure PII is not in screenshots. we should produce a redacted PDF and an attestation snippet. Legal-bot - what wording do you need?

legal-bot: Please include the following attestation line in the package: "Redwood Inference certifies that the attached artifacts were produced during the engagement dated 2026-03-10. Sensitive internal identifiers have been redacted or obfuscated. Contact legal@redwood.com for access to the full unredacted materials under NDA." Also confirm that Lynx has an executed DPA or vendor addendum.

mike: Ops request: deliver via the secure SSO share and encrypt the archive with our PGP key. i'll handle redaction and encryption. example commands i plan to run:

```bash
# export findings CSV from scanner json
jq -r '.findings[] | [.id, .severity, .component, .cve[]?] | @csv' snyk-report.json > findings.csv
# tar and encrypt\ttar -czf lynx-evidence-1769601234.tar.gz nessus.xml snyk-report.json sbom.csv findings.csv report-redacted.pdf
gpg --encrypt --recipient "lynx-security@lynx.com" lynx-evidence-1769601234.tar.gz
```

raj: will also generate sha256 checksums and post them next to the archive. sample: `sha256sum lynx-evidence-1769601234.tar.gz > checksums.txt`.

emma: Good. timeline recommendation from sales: critical (patch/mitigate within 0-14 days), high (2-6 weeks), medium/low (6-12 weeks). Lynx asked for estimated MTTR per severity bucket. assign owners so we can give them a realistic cadence.

sarah: engineering triage suggests owners: critical -> raj, high -> eng-security (triage team), medium/low -> platform team. i'll draft the week-by-week plan and include assumptions (e.g., maintenance windows, change freeze exceptions).

devsec-bot: Export job completed: nessus.xml, snyk-report.json, sbom.csv uploaded to secure-share:/vendor-evidence/lynx/1769601234/ at 2026-03-15T09:14:22Z. Access: sales@redwood + lynx-security granted.

mike: redaction in progress. note: sed/gawk plus manual scrub for screenshots. i will produce two bundles: (A) redacted + attestation for Lynx, (B) full package for SOC (SSO-only link).

emma: Legal says we can't send full unredacted report without a signed addendum. i'll follow up with the customer to confirm they can sign now. if they refuse, we'll only send redacted package.

raj: SBOM mapping done. created sbom_cve_map.csv with columns: package, version, cve, status, jira_ticket. put it in the folder.

mike: Uploaded encrypted archive to secure-share:/vendor-evidence/lynx/1769601234/lynx-evidence-1769601234.tar.gz.gpg and published checksums.txt.

devsec-bot: ACL update: lynx-security@lynx.com granted read on secure-share:/vendor-evidence/lynx/1769601234/ at 2026-03-15T10:05:00Z. Logs stored.

emma: Action owners and deadlines (final):
- mike: finish redaction + create encrypted archive + checksums by 2026-03-15 11:00 PT
- raj: confirm SBOM mapping + jira links + finalize findings.csv by 2026-03-15 11:00 PT
- sarah: produce remediation timeline doc + MTTR estimates by 2026-03-15 12:00 PT
- emma: confirm NDA/addendum status with Lynx and send delivery note by 2026-03-15 15:00 PT

sarah: i'll include a small mitigation note per finding (config change or patch target) and estimate dev hours where possible.

emma: once everything is uploaded, i'll send Lynx a short email with the SSO link, the checksum, and the attestation text. cc legal.

mike: done with encryption and checksums. posted link in the secure share. :white_check_mark:

raj: finished csv and jira links. quick sanity check: we have 2 critical, 7 high, 18 medium/low. tagging eng-security for triage.

emma: Thanks — i'll craft the send and ping here when emailed. if legal needs to review the attestation wording before send, tag legal-bot. :thumbsup:
